title: Kubernetes pod OOMKilled causing cascading restarts
symptoms: K8s events: OOMKilled: Container exceeded memory limit 512Mi. Pod restart count reached 47 in 30 minutes. CrashLoopBackOff on 8 of 10 api-pod replicas. 502 error rate at 80%. Logs: Warning default/api-pod-7f8b OOMKilling: Container killed.
root_cause: A memory leak in the image processing library (Pillow 9.x) caused each request handling a large image to retain 50MB of memory. Under sustained traffic, each pod grew to 2GB before OOMKill. The memory leak was introduced with a silent dependency upgrade.
fix_applied: 1. Scaled down to 2 replicas and disabled image processing endpoint. 2. Pinned Pillow version to 8.4.0 (known-good). 3. Increased pod memory limit to 1.5Gi as interim. 4. Added memory profiling with py-spy in staging. 5. Implemented automatic pod recycling every 6 hours.
